template_similarity

2025-11-15

first, look at correlation between two regressors

subjects_list <- load_fmri3_subjects()

reg_corr_list <- NULL
all_reg <- NULL
for (sub in subjects_list$X1) {
  file_pupil <- file.path(MIDAFFEMO_ROOT, "regs_corr", paste0(sub, "_pupil_scaled_c.1D"))
  pupil_reg <- read_delim(file_pupil, delim = "\t", col_names = FALSE)
  file_rating <- file.path(MIDAFFEMO_ROOT, "regs_corr", paste0(sub, "_report_param_arous_c.1D"))
  rating_reg <- read_delim(file_rating, delim = "\t", col_names = FALSE)
  reg_corr_list <- rbind(
    reg_corr_list,
    summary(lm(scale(pupil_reg$X1) ~ scale(rating_reg$X1)))$coefficients[2, ]
  )
  all_reg <- rbind(all_reg, cbind(pupil_reg, rating_reg, subject = sub))
}

reg_corr_list <- as.data.frame(reg_corr_list)
reg_corr_list$subject <- subjects_list$X1
mean(reg_corr_list$Estimate)
## [1] 0.04231444
sd(reg_corr_list$Estimate)
## [1] 0.07470128
t.test(reg_corr_list$Estimate,mu=0)
## 
##  One Sample t-test
## 
## data:  reg_corr_list$Estimate
## t = 2.7166, df = 22, p-value = 0.0126
## alternative hypothesis: true mean is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  0.01001118 0.07461769
## sample estimates:
##  mean of x 
## 0.04231444
all_reg <- as.data.frame(all_reg)
names(all_reg) <- c("pupil","rating","subject")
summary(lmer(scale(pupil)~scale(rating)+ (1|subject),all_reg))
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method ['lmerModLmerTest']
## Formula: scale(pupil) ~ scale(rating) + (1 | subject)
##    Data: all_reg
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: 64443.6
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -5.2908 -0.5501  0.0519  0.6596  3.2835 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance Std.Dev.
##  subject  (Intercept) 0.0000   0.0000  
##  Residual             0.9974   0.9987  
## Number of obs: 22724, groups:  subject, 23
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                 Estimate Std. Error         df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)   -1.901e-16  6.625e-03  2.272e+04   0.000        1    
## scale(rating)  5.122e-02  6.625e-03  2.272e+04   7.731 1.11e-14 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr)
## scale(rtng) 0.000 
## optimizer (nloptwrap) convergence code: 0 (OK)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')

read in motion data

all_sub_beh_data <- load_motion_censor(subjects_list)

split-half validation

make dataframe of all similarities, all thresholds

first half (using h2 template)

glm_arrays_run12 <- load_fmri3_glm_arrays("h2", 1:490, subjects_list)
timing_run12 <- build_trial_timing_template(c("run-01", "run-02"))

my_array_s1_run12 <- join_glm_arrays_with_timing(
  glm_arrays_run12, timing_run12, "run12"
)

second half (using h1 template)

glm_arrays_run34 <- load_fmri3_glm_arrays("h1", 491:980, subjects_list)
timing_run34 <- build_trial_timing_template(c("run-03", "run-04"))

my_array_s1_run34 <- join_glm_arrays_with_timing(
  glm_arrays_run34, timing_run34, "run34", tr_offset = 490L
)
my_array_s1 <- rbind(my_array_s1_run12,my_array_s1_run34) %>% 
  left_join(all_sub_beh_data, by = c("subject","tr")) %>%  #combine censor file
  filter(censor == 1) #motion censoring

get self-reported arousal template

my_array_s1__ <- prepare_template_long(
  my_array_s1, TS_COL$glm_arousal, fmri3_data_2probes
)

d1<-my_array_s1__ %>% 
         filter(!is.na(hit)) %>% 
         group_by(tr_in_trial,subject,threshold,probe) %>% 
         summarise(glmArousal = mean(glmArousal,na.rm = T)) %>% 
         group_by(tr_in_trial,threshold,probe) %>% 
         summarise(mean = mean(glmArousal,na.rm = T),
                   se = sd(glmArousal,na.rm = T)/sqrt(n()))

d2<-my_array_s1__ %>% 
         filter(!is.na(hit),
                tr_in_trial == 5) %>% 
         group_by(subject,threshold,cue_value) %>% 
         summarise(glmArousal = mean(glmArousal,na.rm = T)) %>% 
         group_by(threshold,cue_value) %>% 
         summarise(mean = mean(glmArousal,na.rm = T),
                   se = sd(glmArousal,na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>% 
  mutate(cue_value = factor(cue_value, levels = c("-$5","-$1","-$0","+$0","+$1","+$5")))

predicting performance

get_stats <- function(model) {
  b <- coef(summary(model))["scale(glmArousal)", "Estimate"]
  p <- coef(summary(model))["scale(glmArousal)", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  list(beta = round(b, 3), p = signif(p, 3))
}

predictive performance

data_used <- my_array_s1_ %>%
  filter(tr_in_trial == 5, threshold == 0.5) %>%
  mutate(hit_num = as.integer(hit == "Hit")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(glmPupil), !is.na(hit_num))

# Refit the hit model in this chunk so predictions are not affected by
# other chunks that reuse l1 (e.g. RT or cue-value models).
l1_hit <- glmer(
  hit_num ~ scale(glmPupil) + (1 | split),
  family = binomial,
  data = data_used
)

pred_probs <- predict(
  l1_hit,
  newdata = data_used,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NA
)

pred_class <- as.integer(pred_probs > 0.5)
actual_class <- data_used$hit_num

accuracy <- mean(pred_class == actual_class)
accuracy
## [1] 0.5867107
table(Predicted = pred_class, Actual = actual_class)
##          Actual
## Predicted    0    1
##         0   45   31
##         1  846 1200
roc_obj <- pROC::roc(actual_class, pred_probs)
## Setting levels: control = 0, case = 1
## Setting direction: controls < cases
pROC::auc(roc_obj)
## Area under the curve: 0.5543
set.seed(777)
ci <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = 2000)
ci
## 95% CI: 0.5296-0.5784 (2000 stratified bootstrap replicates)

ggplot(df_cue, aes(x = tr, y = Estimate))+
  geom_line(aes(color= probe))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey",
             size = 1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  facet_wrap(~threshold)+
  labs(title = "FMRI study")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(TR_DELAY))

p_thresh_cue<-ggplot(df_cue %>% filter(tr == 5), aes(x = threshold, y = Estimate))+
  geom_point(aes(color= probe))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(color= probe, x = threshold, ymin = Estimate - se,
                    ymax = Estimate + se), width = 0.1)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey",
             size = 1)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  labs(title = "Abs cue value")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(TR_DELAY))+
  annotate("rect",xmin = 0.25,xmax = 0.75, ymin = 0.1,ymax = 0.8,alpha = 0.1)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

summary(l1 <- lmer(
  scale(cue_value_abs) ~ scale(glmPupil) + (1 | split),
  my_array_s1_ %>%
    filter(tr_in_trial == 5, threshold == 0.5) %>%
    mutate(cue_value_abs = cue_value_to_abs(cue_value))
))
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method ['lmerModLmerTest']
## Formula: scale(cue_value_abs) ~ scale(glmPupil) + (1 | split)
##    Data: my_array_s1_ %>% filter(tr_in_trial == 5, threshold == 0.5) %>%  
##     mutate(cue_value_abs = cue_value_to_abs(cue_value))
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: 5937.3
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -1.3556 -0.7823 -0.5051  1.2244  1.9934 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance Std.Dev.
##  split    (Intercept) 0.0000   0.000   
##  Residual             0.9565   0.978   
## Number of obs: 2122, groups:  split, 2
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                  Estimate Std. Error        df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)     2.473e-03  2.123e-02 2.120e+03   0.116    0.907    
## scale(glmPupil) 2.087e-01  2.118e-02 2.120e+03   9.850   <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr)
## scl(glmPpl) 0.009 
## optimizer (nloptwrap) convergence code: 0 (OK)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
summary(lmer(
  scale(cue_value_abs) ~ scale(glmPupil) + scale(pupil_lag2) + (1 | split),
  my_array_s1_ %>%
    filter(tr_in_trial == 5, threshold == 0.5) %>%
    mutate(cue_value_abs = cue_value_to_abs(cue_value))
))
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method ['lmerModLmerTest']
## Formula: scale(cue_value_abs) ~ scale(glmPupil) + scale(pupil_lag2) +      (1 | split)
##    Data: my_array_s1_ %>% filter(tr_in_trial == 5, threshold == 0.5) %>%  
##     mutate(cue_value_abs = cue_value_to_abs(cue_value))
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: 5850.3
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -1.5809 -0.7822 -0.4590  1.1352  2.4059 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance  Std.Dev.
##  split    (Intercept) 0.0000416 0.00645 
##  Residual             0.9158786 0.95702 
## Number of obs: 2122, groups:  split, 2
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                    Estimate Std. Error        df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)       6.270e-03  2.127e-02 9.726e-01   0.295    0.819    
## scale(glmPupil)   1.659e-01  2.119e-02 2.111e+03   7.832 7.56e-15 ***
## scale(pupil_lag2) 2.059e-01  2.113e-02 1.558e+03   9.744  < 2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr) scl(P)
## scl(glmPpl)  0.004       
## scl(ppl_l2)  0.018 -0.207
# Get effect size (standardized beta)
beta <- summary(l1)$coefficients["scale(glmPupil)", "Estimate"]
r2   <- r.squaredGLMM(l1)[1]

# Create base plot
p5m2p <- plot_model(l1, type = "pred", terms = "glmPupil") +
  labs(x = "similarity to arousal template (z-score)",
    y = "abs. cue value (z-score)",
    title = "abs. cue value (z-score)"
  ) +
  annotate("text",x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = paste0("β = ", round(beta, 2), ", R²m = ", round(r2, 2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -1.5, size = 4)

# Extract coefficients and p-values
get_stats <- function(model) {
  b <- coef(summary(model))["scale(glmPupil)", "Estimate"]
  p <- coef(summary(model))["scale(glmPupil)", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  list(beta = round(b, 3), p = signif(p, 3))
}

# get the cross-correlogram
lags <- -3:8


lag_results <- lapply(lags, function(l){

  dat_lag <- my_array_s1 %>%
    filter(threshold == 0.5) %>%
    group_by(subject, split) %>%
    mutate(pupil_lag = if (l >= 0) {lag(pupil,  l)} 
           else {lead(pupil, -l)}
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(pupil_lag), !is.na(glmPupil))

  m <- lmer(
    scale(glmPupil) ~ scale(pupil_lag) + (1 | split),
    data = dat_lag,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  broom.mixed::tidy(m) %>%
    filter(term == "scale(pupil_lag)") %>%
    mutate(lag = l)
})
